texts.preamble: Sri Balamurugan Sago Industries vs Food Safety And Standards Authority Of ... on 3 January, 2022 Author: Krishnan Ramasamy Bench: Krishnan Ramasamy W.P.No.16 In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated 03.01.2022 Coram The Honourable Mr.Justice Krishnan Ramasamy W.P.No.16126 of 2018 and W.M.P.No.19158 of 2018 Sri Balamurugan Sago Industries Rep.by its Managing Partner N.Kanagaraj, No.35/5, Main Road, Namagiripet, Rasipuram Taluk, Namakkal District. ... Petitio Vs. 1.Food Safety and Standards Authority of India, [Ministry of Health and Family Welfare], Fda Bhavan, Kotla Road, New Delhi 110 002. 2.Commissioner of Food Safety, No.359, Anna Salai, V Floor, Dms Office Building, Dms Campus, Teynampet, Chennai 600 006. 3.Designated Officer, Food Safety and Drug Administration Department, Namakkal District. 4.Designated Officer, Food Safety and Drug Administration Department, Salem District. ...
texts.arguments: However, he submits that the 3rd and 4th respondents are acting impartiality against the petitioner / Sri Balamurugan Sago Industries. Therefore, the learned counsel for the petitioner seeks appropriate instructions for the respondents to ensure impartiality and transparency in implementing the Food Safety and Standards Act. 3. On the other hand, the learned Special Government Pleader appearing for the respondents would submit that all the officers are acting impartiality and there is no truth in the submissions made by the petitioner. Further he submits that the Appeal was also disposed of.
texts.petitioner_arguments: However, he submits that the 3rd and 4th respondents are acting impartiality against the petitioner / Sri Balamurugan Sago Industries. Therefore, the learned counsel for the petitioner seeks appropriate instructions for the respondents to ensure impartiality and transparency in implementing the Food Safety and Standards Act. 3. On the other hand, the learned Special Government Pleader appearing for the respondents would submit that all the officers are acting impartiality and there is no truth in the submissions made by the petitioner. Further he submits that the Appeal was also disposed of.
